# NX Serve

> NX Serve is a Saudi white-label platform for launching on-demand service businesses (towing, logistics, home services) with Moyasar split payments, live tracking and an API. It is configurable and multi-tenant: services, prices and workflows are edited in a console as data, with no app release.

## Product
- White-label web storefront and provider portal for every plan; branded iOS and Android apps on the Advanced plan.
- Configuration engine: verticals, categories, dynamic fields, workflows and pricing are data.
- Moyasar split payments: funds flow directly to each recipient; the platform never holds funds and card data never touches its servers.
- Live tracking, smart dispatch, dynamic pricing, and an API platform with OpenAPI, SDK and webhooks.
- Bilingual Arabic and English at full parity, RTL-first. Compliance: ZATCA e-invoicing, PDPL, Nafath, KYB.
